items.title: Is Ford Stock Worth Buying Now As F-Series Production Rebounds?
items.summary: Ford's F-Series production is rebounding, but weak U.S. sales, plunging EV demand and rising costs keep the stock outlook balanced.

items.title: Uber Partners Wayve as Autonomous Rides Make U.K. Debut: What's Ahead?
items.summary: Uber and Wayve launch supervised autonomous rides in London, starting a gradual U.K. rollout tied to demand, tech readiness and regulation.

items.title: Ford Risks Another Big EV Failure
items.summary: Ford just unveiled its latest electric vehicle with bold sales targets, but the company faces a collision of forces that sank its previous EV ambitions and shows no sign of letting up.

items.title: What's Behind Ford's Recall of Nearly 149K Mustang Vehicles?
items.summary: F recalls nearly 149K Mustang vehicles over an electrical wiring defect that could cause loss of drive power or disrupt key functions.

items.title: ‘Needs to Be Paid Off Tonight’: Ramsey Gives Controversial Advice To Caller With 2% Mortgage And Pile Of Cash
items.summary: Dave Ramsey told a Houston caller to wipe out his mortgage by nightfall, but the caller's rock-bottom interest rate and a pile of cash create a math problem Ramsey's advice refuses to acknowledge.

items.title: Ford targets 100,000 first-year sales for Fathom electric truck
items.summary: The Fathom, set for production in early 2027, would be the first non-Tesla EV to reach that sales milestone in the U.S.

items.title: Unifor opens contract talks with Stellantis covering over 9,000 Canadian workers
items.summary: Stellantis is the last of the Detroit Three to start contract talks with Unifor, following pattern deals with Ford and General Motors.

items.title: Uber and AI firm Wayve launch first self-driving robotaxis in London
items.summary: The companies said they are operating a ‘small fleet’ of all-electric Ford Mustang Mach-E vehicles.
